title: Ledger wallet app data
whyItMatters: Ledger's desktop app stores account names, settings and caches in app.json. It shows which accounts were tracked, though keys stay on the device.
source: Ledger support: user data under macOS Library/Application Support/Ledger Wallet - https://support.ledger.com/article/8490479490333-zd
notes: Glob covers the current 'Ledger Wallet' folder and the older 'Ledger Live' name. app.json is never opened; the recovery phrase is not on disk here.
